name: omamigrate
description: Portable Omarchy migration backups for apps, AI credentials, proxy services, system configurations, and automated workflows.
description_good_justification: OmaMigrate creates portable backups of installed package lists, selected user configurations, AI credentials, proxy and system service configurations, and automated workflows. See https://github.com/luneth90/omamigrate#readme
interact_justification: Installation instructions are in https://github.com/luneth90/omamigrate#readme, feedback and issues at https://github.com/luneth90/omamigrate/issues, and contribution guide at https://github.com/luneth90/omamigrate/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
floss_license_justification: The software is released under the MIT License, which is a recognized Free/Libre and Open Source Software (FLOSS) license. See https://github.com/luneth90/omamigrate/blob/main/LICENSE
floss_license_osi_justification: The MIT License is explicitly approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI): https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT
documentation_interface_justification: The README and manifest document the CLI command interface, overlay UI, backup formats, and migration flows: https://github.com/luneth90/omamigrate#readme
repo_public_justification: Repository on GitHub, which provides public git repositories with URLs.
repo_track_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git can track the changes, who made them, and when they were made.
repo_distributed_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git is distributed.
release_notes_justification: Non-trivial release notes file in repository: <https://github.com/luneth90/omamigrate/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md>.
report_process_justification: Non-trivial SECURITY[.md] file found in repository: <https://github.com/luneth90/omamigrate/blob/main/SECURITY.md>.
discussion_justification: GitHub supports discussions on issues and pull requests.
english_justification: All core documentation (README.md, CHANGELOG.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md) and commit messages are in English. GitHub issues and pull requests are accepted in English.
maintained_justification: The project is actively maintained with frequent commits, official release (v1.0.0), automated CI/CD, and weekly Dependabot dependency updates: https://github.com/luneth90/omamigrate/commits/main
